route.island_harbour: Coastal run to the Island Harbour
route.dp.early_dates: The gardener will sell this year's dates now, or more if you wait for the last of the harvest.
route.dp.salt_flat: A shortcut crosses the sabkha. The crust can break under loaded camels.
route.dp.heat: Rest at the well through the worst of the day, or push on.
route.dp.guide: A local guide knows the wells and the tracks, for a fee.
route.dp.market: Sell in the morning at a steady price, or wait for the traders from the mountains in the evening.
route.dp.heading: Hug the coast, or sail straight across the open sea?
route.dp.reef_channel: Wait for the high tide, or take the channel now.
route.dp.harbour_fee: Pay the harbour master and trade in the souq, or anchor outside and trade from the boat.
route.dp.wind: Leave on the early wind, or wait a day for a steadier one.
route.dp.storm: A storm on the horizon. Shelter in a cove for a day, or run before the wind.
route.dp.dealers: Sell to the first buyer who meets you at the quay, or visit the dealers in the market.
route.out.spoiled: The late batch spoiled. Half the cargo was lost.
route.out.crust_broke: The crust broke. A quarter of the cargo was lost, but home sooner.
route.out.lame_camel: A camel went lame. Much of the cargo was left behind.
route.out.fee_paid: The guide was paid. No trouble on the way.
route.out.lost_day: The old tracks were wrong. A day was lost.
route.out.traders_came: The mountain traders came and paid well.
route.out.no_traders: The traders never came. Prices fell in the evening.
route.out.reef: The hull scraped a reef. Later voyages earn less until it is repaired.
route.out.fair_winds: Fair winds. The open sea paid more.
route.out.storm: A storm. Half the cargo was washed overboard.
route.out.fee_paid_friends: The fee was paid. The Island Harbour remembers it kindly.
route.out.fee_kept: The fee was kept. The harbour master was not pleased.
route.out.slow_passage: The wind failed. A slow passage.
route.out.cargo_overboard: The storm caught the ship. A third of the cargo was lost.
route.out.price_low: The dealers paid less than the quay. The coin comes an hour later.
route.out.price_good: The dealers paid a fair premium. The coin comes an hour later.
route.out.price_high: A dealer paid handsomely. The coin comes an hour later.
err.needs_building: You need another building before you can send this route.
err.no_free_route: All your routes are out. Wait for one to return.
err.route_not_back: This route has not returned yet.
err.no_decision: There is no decision to make right now.

ui.research_help: Three studies in order. The last one unlocks the fort.
ui.fort_help: Built in three stages, paid over several visits.

ui.question_placeholder: Placeholder: count one correct answer (questions arrive later)

desc.well: Brings up fresh water. Every other building needs water to work.
desc.date_grove: Date palms that feed the town. They grow best beside water.
desc.fish_trap: A reed fence in the shallows (hadra) that traps fish on the falling tide.
desc.barasti_house: Homes built of palm fronds. Families make nearby markets and meeting places busier.
desc.souq: The market. Traders bring coin, and caravans to the oasis leave from here.
desc.jetty: Where boats tie up. Opens the sea routes.
desc.pearl_merchant: Buys and grades pearls from the boats. Earns coin.
desc.majlis: Where the town meets and talks. Earns reputation.
desc.scribe_house: Keeps records and teaches. Earns knowledge for research.
desc.watchtower: Watches the coast. Its defence matters once the rival town arrives.
desc.treasury: A strong room for coin. Raises how much coin you can hold.
desc.storehouse: Lets the buildings beside it hold 50% more before they fill.

tut.welcome.quote: Every age has its town. This one has not been born yet. Its fortune lies under the water.
tut.welcome.do: I am the Rawi, the storyteller. I will walk with you through your first steps. Drag to look around; pinch to zoom.
tut.well.quote: Before pearls, water. Nothing grows here without it.
tut.well.do: Tap Build, choose the Well, then tap a glowing plot.
tut.grove.do: Now plant a Date grove right next to your well. Groves beside water grow 25% more.
tut.collect.quote: The town works while you are gone.
tut.collect.do: Your grove is filling with dates. When its bar is white, tap Collect.
tut.souq.do: Food alone does not make a town. Build a Souq: it earns coin and opens caravans.
tut.route.quote: Every road asks a question. Today, either answer is safe.
tut.route.do: Tap Routes and send the errand to the date gardens.
tut.choice.do: Your errand is on its way; its marker is on the left. When it lights up, a choice is waiting: tap it and pick one.
tut.unload.quote: The road pays those who use it.
tut.unload.do: The errand is home. Open it and unload the cargo.
tut.upgrade.quote: Tend it, and it gives more.
tut.upgrade.do: Tap your date grove and upgrade it.
tut.goals.quote: When the great dive begins, you will need more than courage. You will need a fort, and friends.
tut.goals.do: Three goals end this age: research, the Great Fort and the Chronicle. Tap Goals to see them. The bar at the bottom always shows a good next step.
tut.done: That is all I have to teach for now. The bar at the bottom will always suggest a next step.
ui.reset_confirm: Tap New town again to start over. Your town will be lost.
ui.sell_help: The more you sell at once, the lower the price. It recovers over a day; market day pays more.
ui.no_more_today: That is all for today. More questions tomorrow.
ui.all_answered: Every question for this age is answered.
ui.archive_locked: Answer questions to open this page
ui.draft_note: Draft written from cited sources; a historian will review it before release.

err.question_cap: That is all the questions for today.
